testCases.name: CLI Organization Creation
testCases.description: Verify CLI can create organizations and records are stored in SurrealDB
validationSteps: Execute: python -m server.cli admin org create --org-id test-validation-org --name 'Validation Test Organization'
Verify: CLI command exits with code 0
Query: SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE org_id = 'test-validation-org'
Assert: Database record exists with matching org_id and name

testCases.name: CLI User Creation with Password Hashing
testCases.description: Verify CLI can create users with bcrypt password hashing
validationSteps: Execute: echo 'TestPass123!\nTestPass123!' | python -m server.cli admin user create --email validation@test.com --name 'Validation Test User' --org-id test-validation-org --role admin
Verify: CLI command exits with code 0
Query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = 'validation@test.com'
Assert: Database record exists
Assert: password_hash starts with '$2' (bcrypt)
Assert: password_hash != plain text password

testCases.name: CLI Boredom Configuration
testCases.description: Verify CLI can configure template boredom eligibility and priority
validationSteps: Prerequisite: Ensure template exists in activity_template table
Execute: python -m server.cli admin template set-boredom --template-id <id> --enable --priority 0.85
Verify: CLI command exits with code 0
Query: SELECT boredom_eligible, boredom_priority FROM activity_template WHERE variant_id = '<id>'
Assert: boredom_eligible = true
Assert: boredom_priority = 0.85 (within 0.01 tolerance)

testCases.name: Dashboard Navigation and Authentication
testCases.description: Verify dashboard loads and handles authentication in local mode
validationSteps: Playwright: Navigate to http://app.metabob.local
Playwright: Take screenshot 01-dashboard-home.png
Playwright: Check if login form is visible
Playwright: Fill email and password fields
Playwright: Click submit button
Playwright: Wait for navigation
Playwright: Take screenshot 02-after-login.png
Assert: No authentication errors in console

testCases.name: Activity History Verification
testCases.description: Verify activity data from devbob appears in dashboard UI
validationSteps: Query: SELECT count() FROM activity_content WHERE org_id = 'test-validation-org' GROUP ALL
Assert: Activity count > 0
API: GET /auth/orgs/test-validation-org/activity
Assert: API returns 200
Assert: Response contains activities array
Playwright: Navigate to Activity History page
Playwright: Count activity items in UI
Assert: UI activity count matches API/DB count

testCases.name: Boredom System Statistics
testCases.description: Verify boredom CLI commands show accurate statistics
validationSteps: Execute: python -m server.cli admin boredom stats
Verify: CLI output shows Total Templates, Boredom-Eligible, Average Priority
Query: SELECT count() as total, math::sum(boredom_eligible::bool::number()) as eligible, math::mean(boredom_priority) as avg FROM activity_template GROUP ALL
Assert: DB stats match CLI output

testCases.name: Browser Console API Call Verification
testCases.description: Verify dashboard makes successful API calls to /analytics/* and /auth/* endpoints
validationSteps: Playwright: Navigate to dashboard
Playwright: Enable request interception
Playwright: Monitor network requests
Playwright: Wait for page load
Filter: Requests to /analytics/* and /auth/*
Assert: At least one /analytics/* request made
Assert: At least one /auth/* request made
Assert: All requests returned 2xx status codes
Playwright: Check console for errors
Assert: No console errors related to API calls

playwrightMCP.note: Use page.on('response') to capture API calls

testCases.name: Data Aggregation Validation
testCases.description: Compare raw SurrealDB records with dashboard UI display to validate aggregation
validationSteps: Query: SELECT * FROM activity_content WHERE activity_id = 'activity-123' LIMIT 1
Store: Raw DB record (cost, tokens, duration, success)
API: GET /auth/orgs/{org_id}/activity
Find: Same activity in API response
Assert: API data matches DB record
Playwright: Navigate to Activity History
Playwright: Locate activity in UI
Playwright: Extract displayed values (cost, tokens, duration)
Assert: UI values match DB/API values
Assert: Aggregation logic (totals, averages) is correct

successCriteria.cliCommands: All CLI commands execute without errors (exit code 0)
successCriteria.databaseRecords: Database records match expected schema and values
successCriteria.dashboardLoad: Dashboard loads without authentication errors in local mode
successCriteria.activityHistory: Activity history shows real data from devbob executions
successCriteria.apiCalls: Browser console logs show successful API calls to /analytics/* and /auth/*
successCriteria.dataAggregation: Raw SurrealDB records match dashboard UI display

data: At least one organization in database
At least one activity_template in database
At least one activity_content record from devbob execution
configuration: Dashboard in local mode (REACT_APP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=local) OR test user created
